plugin.name: Resident Evil HD Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logos at start-up and go straight to the title. The opening movie stays.
UnlockAllResolutions.description: List every display mode of the monitor in the game's resolution menu.
UnlockFPS.description: Raise the cap of the game's VARIABLE frame rate option from 120 to 1000. Higher frame rates may change gameplay timing.
HideMouseCursorAfterMs.description: Hide the mouse cursor after it hasn't moved for this many milliseconds. 0 never hides it.
DoorSkip.description: Skip the door, stairs and lift animations between rooms.
WindowMode.description: The window when the game's own fullscreen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show health and ammunition on supported Logitech keyboards. Requires Logitech G HUB.
DisableNoise.description: Turn off the film grain of the game's noise filter.
DisableColorCorrection.description: Turn off the game's color correction.
DisableCreateQuery.description: Don't wait for the GPU at the end of each frame. A performance workaround that may change rendering.
